annotations.title: Move a post's platform to another connected account

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Re-points platform legs of one post to another healthy connected account of the same brand and platform, e.g. off a disconnected Facebook connection: `switchAccounts` { "facebook": "<accountId>" }. A post HELD for review (pending_review, review_held, missed_review): only flayr's post and its stored review request change; it never approves and the post stays held. `dryRun: true` previews it (status "would_switch"). A SCHEDULED post: the booking at the platform scheduler is changed in place (CHANGES WHAT GOES OUT on a real account; no dryRun). Every switch is audited. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin). Confirm the account with the user first.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/posts/{id}.)

dryRun.description: With `switchAccounts` on a post held for review: preview the switch (status "would_switch"), nothing written. Refused (409) on a scheduled post.

id.description: The post: `convexPostId` from POST /api/v2/publish, or `posts[].id` from GET /api/v2/content/{id}.

switchAccounts.description: Move these platform legs to other accounts, in place: { "facebook": "<accountId>" }. Each account must be a healthy connection of the post's brand on that platform. Send it on its own (only `dryRun` may go with it).

name: switch_post_accounts
